summary.zh: 本次更新修复登出功能失效的问题：登出现在会可靠返回登录页，且残留的旧登录记录不会再自动恢复会话。
summary.en: This update fixes sign-out not working: signing out now reliably returns to the login page, and stale stored accounts no longer auto-restore a session.

items.zh: 修复点击登出后仍显示登录状态的问题
items.en: Fixed the app still appearing signed in after tapping sign out

items.zh: 登出后再次登录的会话现在能在重启后正确保持
items.en: Sessions from a fresh login now correctly persist across app restarts

items.zh: 从任意页面（含深链进入的页面）登出都会正确回到登录页
items.en: Signing out from any screen (including deep-linked ones) now returns to the login page
